desc: The daily seed, part 1 of 2: a daily file (an open-world file stamped with the day's seed DAILY-20261108 by $TTYD_OPEN_SEED, its goal the daily's three Crystal Stars by $TTYD_OPEN_GOAL; the settings page's 'Play today's seed' arms the same seed for a new file) played after the prologue: down tik_02's chapter pipe, chapter 1's title card, into Petal Meadows (hei_00), walked east past Hooktail's shadow (hei_13) to the first enemies (hei_01; hei_00 has none), two field fights played out (the auto-battler, god mode); the stamp read back from the save words (PCOW, 'DAILY-'), the daily's clock counting into daily_20261108.txt, Shuffled earned; saved into file 1 of a card that has one (the 0.4.1 card's), as a Save Block saves. moderun_daily_reload loads it; the stamp's line logs the goal $TTYD_OPEN_GOAL made (3: it once logged 0, read before the goal was put in), and one where gsw line reads all ten stamp bytes (it once kept three); Shuffled, earned on the first check after the file is counted, is earned as new with its toast (it was logged 'already done' and never shown)
